E0414

Unknown `priv(…)` qualifier; only `priv(package)` exists

What

Unknown `priv(…)` qualifier; only `priv(package)` exists

Why

`priv(package) module` is the only qualified module privacy

Fix

Delete the qualifier, or write `priv(package)`.
